pages.text: $(#f4a7ff)【Causality】$()$(br2)Its projectiles home in on their target through walls and hit nothing else.$(br2)$(l)Accessory$(): Chain of Causality, which wards this affix off.
$(l)Dropped material$()$(br2)$(o)Two metal rings that can never quite be parted. Whatever touches one, the other answers.$()
